proposedContributions.change: Define the eight specified entities over shared EntityRef/FileVersion/Principal bindings. Require immutable sourceVersion/contentHash, recipient order, provider capability/policy version, expiry and revision. Keep domain states draft/sent/identity_pending/intent_pending/signing_pending/provider_accepted/signed_artifact_ready/verified/declined/expired/cancelled/unknown separate from unchanged Rox2Status. Sign takes stepRef/sessionRevision/nonce/contentHash/intentDigest/idempotencyKey; actor identity is transport-derived, not a trusted request field. Represent pending/unknown/signed results, provider receipt and separate VerificationRecord; do not equate receipt verification with cryptographic proof.
proposedContributions.prerequisite: Accepted dependency and Revision2 entity/FileVersion/identity/result contracts plus selected provider evidence scope. Exact imports must come from those receipts, not a new identity or document store.

proposedContributions.change: Implement authenticated commands/queries in canonical service transactions with current document.read/export/signing.request/eligible-signer/evidence-export policy. Record immutable manifest/consent policy and actor/time/digest, intent plus command outbox before external call. Enforce source/step/revision/nonce/digest/audience/expiry/revoke and signer order. Persist command aliases and callback event IDs; reconcile duplicate/reordered/late callbacks and unknown sends/cancels without deleting history or issuing an unproven second effect. Schedule expiry/challenge revocation and permitted reminders through foundation jobs/outbox. Do not accept human intent from agent prepare/request/read scopes.
proposedContributions.prerequisite: Canonical transaction/outbox/job/policy/authenticated transport interfaces and RS-SIG-01/RS-APR-02 receipts; external API readback/idempotency/cancel semantics.

proposedContributions.change: Implement chosen provider-specific sign/send/readback/verify-support/cancel and callback authentication using protected provider/HSM credentials. Publish versioned identity assurance/evidence capabilities. Return accepted/pending/unknown and receipt rather than success on timeouts. Correlate idempotency keys to durable commands, validate callback event identity and use readback to resolve ambiguous effects. Provider accepted is not artifact-ready or verified; renderer and MCP never receive private keys.
proposedContributions.prerequisite: Provider conformance receipt, supported evidence policy, dedicated live tenant and real adapter contract; fixture cannot close crypto proof.

proposedContributions.change: Verify exact downloaded artifact and evidence hashes, manifest/intent binding, supported certificate chain/signature/timestamp and versioned verification policy independently of provider acceptance. Unsupported verification scope is explicit. Export uses separate current permission.
proposedContributions.prerequisite: Independent supported cryptographic verifier/trust policy and provider evidence format, canonical FileVersion storage and evidence-export policy.

proposedContributions.change: Add the specified canonical persistence: sourceVersion/hash/providerPolicy/expiry/revision, identity/order/state, append-only actor/time/consent-version/intent-digest records, unique command aliases and provider event IDs scoped to provider/account, artifactHash/certificate/timestamp/verificationPolicy refs and verification records. risks.risk: Hidden foundation gates are not represented by the two explicit DAG edges.
risks.mitigation: Keep explicit dependency array unchanged; require separate per-WP and provider/evidence receipts before source work/live enablement.

risks.risk: Current policy helper or permissionMode could be mistaken for signer/resource authorization.
risks.mitigation: Authenticate actor/challenge and check resource/version/audience/expiry/current grants at shared gateway across every path.

risks.risk: PDF path/render, Inbox done or approval could be mistaken for immutable intent/signature.
risks.mitigation: Use canonical immutable version and separate explicit signer intent; prove zero provider calls for non-signing actions with a working positive control.

risks.risk: Unknown external effect, duplicate callbacks and expiry/cancel races can create duplicate effects or false final state.

risks.risk: Receipt/readback status can be misrepresented as independent cryptographic signature verification.

risks.risk: Cross-entity links, OCR/search/push and agent memory can expand audience or retain revoked evidence metadata.
